title: 隐状态后缀长度
layers: 选定模块的输出隐藏状态序列
layers_en: Output hidden-state sequence of the selected modules

standard.summary: 在选定模块完成 forward 后，将可学习向量拼接到输出 hidden-state sequence 尾部；0 表示关闭。这是 lulynx 工程 prompt，不是论文 Prefix-Tuning (arXiv:2101.00190) 的逐层 attention K/V prefix。
standard.effect: 控制 epilogue 向量数量；可与 prelude 同时使用，参数进入现有优化器与产物保存链。
standard.whenToUse: 需要实验性地在已选模块输出末尾附加少量可学习状态，并能控制训练和推理两端实现时。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要论文 Prefix-Tuning 的逐层 attention K/V 注入、标准 LoRA 互操作，或下游严格要求原序列长度时。

standard_en.summary: After the selected modules finish their forward pass, appends learnable vectors to the end of the output hidden-state sequence; 0 turns it off. This is a lulynx engineering prompt, not the per-layer attention K/V prefix of the paper Prefix-Tuning (arXiv:2101.00190).
standard_en.effect: Controls how many epilogue vectors there are; it can be used together with the prelude, and the parameters join the existing optimizer and artefact-saving chain.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want to experiment with a small amount of extra learnable state appended to the output of the modules you selected, and control both the training and the inference side.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need the paper's per-layer attention K/V injection, interoperability with standard LoRA, or when downstream strictly requires the original sequence length.

advanced.principle: 实现使用 post-forward hook 修改已选模块输出；epilogue 只做 hidden-state sequence 尾部拼接，不注入 per-layer attention K/V。
advanced.intervention: 安装器选择现有模块并注册 forward hook，将 epilogue 向量拼接到输出 hidden states 尾部；仅在输出结构允许安全同步 attention mask 时扩展 mask，否则 fail-fast。
advanced.expectedImpact: 增加 length × hidden_size 个可训练参数；效果取决于具体插入点和下游是否消费扩展后的序列。
advanced.tradeoffs: 产物包含 lulynx 专用附加状态，第三方推理端可能忽略；序列长度改变也可能与下游固定 shape 契约冲突。

advanced_en.principle: The implementation uses post-forward hooks to modify selected modules' outputs; the epilogue only concatenates at the hidden-state sequence's tail — no per-layer attention K/V injection.
advanced_en.intervention: The installer selects existing modules and registers forward hooks, appending epilogue vectors to the output hidden states' tail; the mask is extended only when the output structure allows safe attention-mask synchronization, otherwise it fails fast.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Adds length × hidden_size trainable parameters; the effect depends on the insertion point and whether downstream consumers use the extended sequence.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The artifact contains lulynx-specific extra state that third-party inference consumers may ignore; the changed sequence length can also conflict with downstream fixed-shape contracts.
